name: LP 412-34

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-5076 and LP 412-34 in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 55752218851048320 and 55752974765291264), 2,152 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 7.1e-10: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to TOI-5076, 2,152 AU away.

text.card: LP 412-34 is a star of 3,100 K, bound to TOI-5076 2,152 AU away.
text.introduction: LP 412-34 shares its motion through space with TOI-5076, 2,152 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: LP 412-34's orbit around TOI-5076 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 55752974765291264 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 30,000 of its distance per century
